summary: A DUI arrest was made on April 2, 2024 after Officer Thompson spotted a black BMW swerving on Broadway in Oakland and blowing through a red light at 14th Street. The driver, Robert Fitzgerald, was clearly intoxicated — he failed all field sobriety tests and blew a 0.14% BAC on the portable breathalyzer. Back at the station, the more precise Intoxilyzer confirmed he was well over the limit at 0.13% and 0.12%. Fitzgerald said he'd been at a birthday party. He was booked and his car was impounded. A pedestrian in the crosswalk narrowly avoided being hit when Fitzgerald ran the red light. His SSN on file is 478-93-6152.
